tip: A lease lives or dies on the kilometre cap. Ask yearly driving before you quote a pretty payment.
The trade is its own number. Do not bury a light appraisal inside a discount.
Trust is quoting the limit out loud: third-row room, winter range, the fee on the worksheet.
Ask for the business, then wait. Do not fill the silence with a new discount.
Noir is a styling badge, not a new engine. Read the trim under it.
Value is equipment they will use plus warranty plus payment. It is not a shouted discount.
An offer has term, down payment, fees and taxes. An MSRP alone is not an offer.
A pitch is two features tied to their Tuesday, then a question. Not a tour.
The floor is shared. Vote in a teammate's duel like the customer is yours.
The drive should include the thing they feared: the on-ramp, the parkade, the get-in.
The PHEV uses twin motors plus a 2.4L. The gas Outlander is a 1.5L turbo mild hybrid. Different motors.
308 litres behind the Outlander's third row. Fold it before you promise the stroller and the luggage.
Heated steering wheel starts at Outlander SE, Eclipse Cross SE, and RVR SEL. Know which car you are in.
Innovative Pedal is near one-pedal driving. The brake is still required for a full stop.
Eclipse Cross and the gas Outlander are turbos. RVR ES is a 2.0L. Do not share the word carelessly.
Forward collision mitigation is an aid, not a promise the car cannot hit something.
Lane departure prevention does not mean self-driving. Hands stay on the wheel.
The quota does not pick the car. Their Wednesday does. A wrong unit comes back.
Gross follows the right vehicle. Leading with the GT because the gross is pretty is how you lose Priya.
If a lien is on the trade, say so early. Surprise titles kill deliveries.
Model year matters. 2024 Mirage was the last. Do not sell a 2026 Mirage from memory.
The buyer is everyone who has to say yes, including the spouse who is still at work.
Sales is a service job with a pen at the end. Product knowledge is the service.
Month-end pressure is yours, not theirs. Do not invent a deadline the factory did not set.
The gas Outlander's 48-volt system adds a boost. It does not add a plug.
On the gas Outlander the 12.3-inch digital cluster starts at SEL. The centre screen is already on ES.
At delivery, pair the phone and enroll Connect. A confused Thursday is a sales problem.
A quote without freight, PDI and tax is how a Surrey screenshot beats you.
Warranty terms are whichever comes first. Say the years and the kilometres.
Rates come from the desk or the customer's bank. They do not come from a hopeful sentence.
If the payment only works by hiding a fee, you do not have a deal. You have a future complaint.
Price the trim they are sitting in. ES, SE and PHEV ES are three different sentences.
Walk the trade panels with them. Records and a calm walkaround beat a shrug.
Hands-free liftgate is an SE feature on Outlander and Eclipse Cross. Demo it only if the car has it.
If they want a Corolla, respect it. Compare warranty and winter driving. Do not insult the sedan.
Cargo shape matters more than the badge. Make them put the stroller in.
HomeLink lives in a mirror, and on the gas Outlander that mirror step is SEL. Garage people ask.
Do not promise a full-size spare you have not seen on the unit. Check, then answer.
If they mention a pull or a vibration on the test drive, write it up. Do not talk them out of a feeling.
